tagline: Custom AI agents, managed end to end
positioning: Sirin designs, deploys and manages custom AI agents with the interfaces, integrations and ongoing support required to make them useful inside real businesses.

colors.notes: ink-on-#a57c4f contrast = 4.70:1 (passes 4.5). Sage family is the secondary landscape hue.

typography.display: Canela (licensed, NOT loaded by the site), fallback Cormorant Garamond (Google Fonts), then Georgia serif
typography.body: System sans stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, ...)
typography.google_fonts: Cormorant Garamond is available on Google Fonts; the site itself loads no webfonts
typography.chosen_for_app: System sans stack (their body font) for --font-brand; serif display is a validation question

assets.favicon_svg: favicon.svg (self-inverting wrapper around 512x187 PNG mark) -> frontend/public/favicon.svg
assets.logo_mark_png: 512x187 dark swoosh mark extracted from favicon.svg
assets.og_image: mark + SIRIN AI over coastal cliff photo, 1200x630
assets.wordmark: Site header uses TEXT 'SIRIN AI' in letterspaced caps, not a logo image
